title: International territorial level 2, January 2025 (United Kingdom, generalised, clipped)
description: The middle tier of the ITL geography used for UK economic statistics, between the ITL1 nations and regions and the ITL3 local areas. The 2025 revision renumbers and resplits much of the 2021 tier, so its codes are not interchangeable with it.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "ITL2_JAN_2025_UK_BGC" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/ITL2_JAN_2025_UK_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 46 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
